reviews.title: Great value for the money NVME SSD
reviews.comment: Bottomline up front: A great bargain buy for your SSD data storage needs if you need an NVME SSD but you don't need PCIe Gen 4/5 speeds Got this with a clip coupon taking 10% off the already very reasonable price, making this a no brainer deal.  Shipping was super fast (next day) and product was as described and pictured.  I was a bit leery as I'm not as familiar with this brand, but after scouring reviews both on Amazon and elsewhere, I decided to give it a shot. I immediately put the SSD into my PC build, ensured it was recognized, and then loaded windows to it.  Zero issues whatsoever.  Checking disk properties, all checked out as expected.  Speed seems to be as quick as any other NVME I've used, and even though this is a Gen 3 drive, it's fast enough for 99% of everyday users. For the price, this is a hard one to beat.
